sample_unit: contrast-enhanced chest CT exams (130 dedicated, 63 non-dedicated)

links.outcome: Local diagnostic accuracy, sensitivity and specificity of commercial PE AI on non-dedicated chest CTs
links.effect: Non-dedicated CTs: 90.48% accuracy, sensitivity 0.14, specificity 1.00; overall accuracy 90.16%, specificity 96%, sensitivity 41%, so many incidental PEs missed.
links.quote: Although the high specificity is promising for ruling in PE, the low sensitivity highlights a limitation, as it indicates the algorithm may miss a substantial number of true-positive incidental PEs.

links.outcome: Performance of PE AI when applied to non-dedicated CT studies outside its intended use
links.effect: On non-dedicated contrast-enhanced chest CTs, sensitivity was only 0.14 (specificity 1.00), versus 41% overall sensitivity.
links.quote: The predictions for non-dedicated contrast-enhanced chest CT imaging studies were 90.48% accurate, with a sensitivity of 0.14 and specificity of 1.00.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy (sensitivity and specificity) of a commercial AI tool (Viz PE) on dedicated versus non-dedicated contrast-enhanced chest CT scans retrospectively, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
